_note: One-line plain-English meanings shown on hover in answers. Keys are matched case-insensitively as whole words; list longer phrases before shorter ones they contain.

terms.HbA1c: A blood test showing your average blood sugar over the past 2 to 3 months.
terms.A1c: A blood test showing your average blood sugar over the past 2 to 3 months.
terms.insulin resistance: When the body's cells don't respond well to insulin, so sugar stays in the blood.
terms.insulin sensitivity: How well the body's cells respond to insulin. Higher is better.
terms.glycemic index: A score for how fast a food raises blood sugar compared with pure sugar.
terms.glycemic load: A score combining how fast a food raises blood sugar and how much carbohydrate a serving has.
terms.glycemic control: How well blood sugar is kept in a healthy range over time.
terms.hyperglycemia: Blood sugar that is higher than normal.
terms.hypoglycemia: Blood sugar that is lower than normal, which can cause shakiness or confusion.
terms.fasting glucose: Blood sugar measured after not eating for at least 8 hours.
terms.fasting plasma glucose: Blood sugar measured after not eating for at least 8 hours.
terms.glucose: Sugar in the blood; the body's main source of energy.
terms.insulin: A hormone that helps sugar move from the blood into the body's cells.
terms.pancreas: An organ behind the stomach that makes insulin.
terms.prediabetes: Blood sugar higher than normal but not yet high enough to be called diabetes.
terms.gestational diabetes: Diabetes that first appears during pregnancy.
terms.type 1 diabetes: Diabetes where the body makes little or no insulin.
terms.type 2 diabetes: Diabetes where the body doesn't use insulin well or doesn't make enough of it.
terms.BMI: Body mass index: a number from weight and height used to screen for overweight.
terms.body mass index: A number from weight and height used to screen for overweight.
terms.visceral fat: Fat stored deep in the belly around the organs.
terms.lean mass: The weight of everything in the body except fat, such as muscle and bone.
terms.carbohydrate: Sugars and starches in food that the body turns into blood sugar.
terms.carbohydrates: Sugars and starches in food that the body turns into blood sugar.
terms.dietary fiber: The part of plant foods the body can't digest; it slows how fast sugar enters the blood.
terms.fiber: The part of plant foods the body can't digest; it slows how fast sugar enters the blood.
terms.Mediterranean diet: An eating pattern rich in vegetables, beans, whole grains, fish and olive oil.
terms.low-carbohydrate diet: An eating pattern that limits sugars and starches.
terms.intermittent fasting: An eating pattern that switches between set periods of eating and not eating.
terms.time-restricted eating: Eating only within a set window of hours each day.
terms.continuous glucose monitoring: A small sensor worn on the skin that checks blood sugar all day and night.
terms.CGM: A small sensor worn on the skin that checks blood sugar all day and night.
terms.meta-analysis: A study that pools the results of many earlier studies.
terms.randomized controlled trial: A study where people are assigned by chance to a treatment or a comparison group.
terms.systematic review: A review that searches for and sums up all studies on a question using set rules.
terms.placebo: A dummy treatment with no active ingredient, used for comparison.
terms.cardiovascular: Having to do with the heart and blood vessels.
terms.neuropathy: Nerve damage, often felt as numbness or tingling in the feet or hands.
terms.retinopathy: Damage to the back of the eye that can affect vision.
terms.ketoacidosis: A dangerous build-up of acids in the blood when the body lacks insulin.
terms.metabolic syndrome: A group of conditions (such as high blood pressure and belly fat) that raise the risk of heart disease and diabetes.
